notes.title: The Baddest Grandma COMPETITION!!!
notes.notes:
[b]The Baddest Grandma COMPETITION!!![/b] 

I've put together a little competition!  The highest score on level 19 by Thursday 12/16 at 9AM PST wins a 20$ Steam Giftcard!

[b]Please note[/b] The new content is currently only available by downloading the beta version!

[b]New content will include:[/b]
- Achievements
- Leaderboards
- And 2 new bonus levels: Rattus Spiral and Serpent Trapp.

[b]How to compete:[/b]
- Go into your steam library.
- Right-click on Cat Capacity.
- Click on the Betas tab.
- Then copy/paste in the secret code "Iamatester123".

HAPPY CAT COLLECTING!

Warm regards,
solo dev JT Mitchell
